title: 第3255章 适才相戏耳第3254章 有宝贝
lines: 十朵大道之花同时落下，顿时产生毁天灭地的力量。
只见下方的海域凹陷一片巨大的区域，可怕的力量直接摧毁了拦路的煞风之灵，紧接着，后方的那座岛屿也是剧烈摇晃，并布满了无数道裂痕。
下一秒钟，岛屿也跟着解体，大大小小的碎石朝着四面八方炸开。
塔灵提醒道：“在那，左边位置……”
萧诺目光一凛，其顺着塔灵所示的方向看去，只见在那飞溅的亿万碎石中，赫然有一道闪闪发亮的光芒。
光芒也就拳头大小，在里边包裹着一物。
萧诺身形一闪，瞬间追了上去，伸手将那道光芒给接入了掌心。
萧诺心生一丝困惑。
这竟然是一枚小小的玉牌。
玉牌为长方形，长度约为大拇指差不多，宽度是长度的三分之二。
在它的上面镌刻着神秘的符文图案。
淡淡的银白色光芒在上面闪烁，透露着一种特殊的道韵。
“这是什么？”
萧诺询问道。
法宝不像是法宝！
塔灵回答道：“这像是开启某个地方的密匙！”
萧诺一愣：“密匙？”
塔灵旋即询问月瑶法神：“法神大人，你觉得呢？”
月瑶法神声音慵懒的回答：“嗯，你说对了，这的确是打开某个禁制的钥匙，等会研究研究……”
话音刚落，
萧诺前方的海域掀起滔天浪潮，浩浩荡荡的煞风汇聚在一起，以肉眼可见的速度凝聚成一尊体格庞大的煞风之灵。
“又来了……”萧诺眉头轻皱。
不等煞风之灵凝聚成型，萧诺便化作一道金色遁光离去。
萧诺并没有要继续战斗的意思。
毕竟这里还不是真正的“万族战场”，没必要把精力浪费在这片海域。
反正东西已经拿到了，可以离开。
旋即，萧诺把手中的玉牌收入储物袋中，然后朝着来时的方向飞去。
萧诺移速很快，不多一会，萧诺就看到了前方的上空悬浮着一座传送阵。
在那传送阵下方的那片海域，镇守着好几尊煞风之灵。
这几道煞风之灵一看到萧诺过来，二话不说，朝着萧诺发起攻击，萧诺随手挥出几道剑气，将它们斩灭成一团接一团错乱气流。
在远处的虚空中，也还有其他的传送阵。
这些传送阵都是通往“万族战场”内部的。
萧诺选择了最近的一座，身形一闪，飞身进入里边。
白光一闪，萧诺当即离开了煞风海域。
下一瞬间，萧诺就落在了一座巍峨的山峰上。
尔后，呈现在萧诺面前的是一片古老之地。
这片古老之地的面积很大，远处还有打斗的声音传来。
“这里便是‘万族战场’了么？”萧诺心中升起些许期待。
content_en:
Ten flowers of the avenue fell at the same time, immediately producing the power to destroy the world.
I saw a huge area dented in the sea below. The terrifying power directly destroyed the evil wind spirit blocking the road. Immediately afterwards, the island behind also shook violently and was covered with countless cracks.
"Bang!"
The next second, the island also disintegrated, and large and small gravels exploded in all directions.
Talling reminded: "There, on the left..."
Xiao Nuo's eyes were sharp. He looked in the direction shown by the tower spirit and saw a shining light among the billions of scattered rubble.
The light is about the size of a fist, and it wraps something inside.
Xiao Nuo's body flashed and he immediately chased after him. He stretched out his hand and put the light into his palm.
"Huh?"
Xiao Nuo felt confused.
This turned out to be a small jade plaque.
The jade tablet is rectangular, about the length of your thumb, and its width is two-thirds of its length.
Mysterious rune patterns are engraved on it.
A faint silvery white light flickers on it, revealing a special Taoist charm.
"What is this?"
Xiao Nuo asked.
The magic weapon does not look like a magic weapon!
Ta Ling replied: "This is like a key to a certain place!"
Xiao Nuo was stunned: "Key?"
The tower spirit immediately asked Dharma God Yueyao: "Dharma God, what do you think?"
Dharma God Yueyao replied in a lazy voice: "Well, you are right, this is indeed the key to unlocking a certain restriction. I will study it later..."
As soon as he finished speaking,
The sea area in front of Xiao Nuo set off a huge wave, and the mighty evil wind gathered together, condensing into a huge evil wind spirit at a speed visible to the naked eye.
"Here we go again..." Xiao Nuo frowned slightly.
Before the evil wind spirit could condense and take shape, Xiao Nuo turned into a golden ray of light and left.
Xiao Nuo had no intention of continuing to fight.
After all, this is not a true "battlefield of all races", so there is no need to waste energy on this sea area.
Anyway, I have got my things and can leave.
Immediately, Xiao Nuo put the jade token in his hand into his storage bag, and then flew in the direction he came from.
"Uh-huh!"
Xiao Nuo moved very quickly. After a while, Xiao Nuo saw a teleportation array suspended in the sky in front of him.
In the sea area below the teleportation array, there were several evil wind spirits guarding it.
As soon as these evil wind spirits saw Xiao Nuo coming, they attacked Xiao Nuo without saying a word. Xiao Nuo casually waved a few sword energy, killing them into a bunch of chaotic airflow.
In the distant void, there are other teleportation arrays.
These teleportation arrays all lead to the inside of the "Battlefield of Ten Thousand Races".
Xiao Nuo chose the nearest one, and in a flash, he flew inside.
"Uh-huh!"
With a flash of white light, Xiao Nuo immediately left the evil wind sea area.
The next moment, Xiao Nuo landed on a towering mountain peak.
Afterwards, what appeared in front of Xiao Nuo was an ancient land.
This ancient land is very large, and there are sounds of fighting in the distance.
"Is this the 'battlefield of all races'?" Xiao Nuo felt a little hopeful.
